name: Walking
summary: A foundational low-impact aerobic exercise involving continuous, alternating bipedal forward locomotion.

setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, shoulders relaxed, and arms loose at your sides.
Fix your gaze straight ahead with your chin level and torso upright.
steps: Step forward with one foot, striking lightly with the heel and rolling through to push off with the forefoot.
Simultaneously swing the opposite arm forward in a natural, fluid arc.
Repeat with the other leg to establish a continuous, rhythmic walking gait.
Maintain a steady cadence and upright posture throughout the bout.
instructions.breathing: Breathe naturally and rhythmically in synchronization with your stride cadence.

common_faults.fault: Slouching forward or looking down at the feet
common_faults.correction: Keep your gaze forward toward the horizon and pull your shoulders gently back and down.

common_faults.fault: Overstriding by reaching the lead foot too far forward
common_faults.correction: Take shorter, quicker strides so your foot lands closer beneath your center of mass.

precautions: Wear supportive, well-fitting athletic shoes suitable for walking terrain.
